description: This file defines the Policy interface for managing access control policies, including methods for creating, modifying, and serializing policies, as well as nested classes for JSON field definitions.

classes.name: Policy.JsonFields
classes.description: Immutable class defining JSON field definitions used in Policy serialization.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyBuilder with a specified PolicyId or CharSequence, deprecated version accepts CharSequence.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new PolicyBuilder initialized with the current Policy's entries.

methods.name: getEntityId
methods.description: Returns the optional PolicyId of the Policy.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Deprecated method returning the Policy's ID as String.

methods.name: getSupportedSchemaVersions
methods.description: Returns the supported JSON schema versions, only V_2.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace of the Policy.

methods.name: getLifecycle
methods.description: Returns the current lifecycle state of the Policy.

methods.name: hasLifecycle
methods.description: Checks if the Policy has a specific lifecycle.

methods.name: getLabels
methods.description: Returns all labels associated with the Policy.

methods.name: contains
methods.description: Checks if the Policy contains an entry for a specific label.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Sets a PolicyEntry, replacing any existing entry with the same label.

methods.name: getEntryFor
methods.description: Retrieves the PolicyEntry for a specific label.

methods.name: removeEntry
methods.description: Removes a PolicyEntry by label or by PolicyEntry object.

methods.name: setSubjectsFor
methods.description: Sets Subjects for a specific label, replacing existing ones.

methods.name: setSubjectFor
methods.description: Sets a Subject for a specific label.

methods.name: removeSubjectFor
methods.description: Removes a Subject or SubjectId from a specific label.

methods.name: setResourcesFor
methods.description: Sets Resources for a specific label.

methods.name: setResourceFor
methods.description: Sets a Resource for a specific label.

methods.name: removeResourceFor
methods.description: Removes Resources or specific ResourceKey/Resource from a label.

methods.name: setEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Sets EffectedPermissions for a resource in a label.

methods.name: getEffectedPermissionsFor
methods.description: Retrieves EffectedPermissions for a subject and resource in a label.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the Policy has no entries.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the number of entries in the Policy.

methods.name: getEntriesSet
methods.description: Returns a modifiable set of all PolicyEntries.

methods.name: stream
methods.description: Returns a Stream of PolicyEntries.

methods.name: toInlinedJson
methods.description: Serializes the Policy to a JSON object for embedding, with predicate or field selector.
